ai.acceptanceBoundary: Controlled UI fixtures only. Live-provider grounding, rate-window enforcement, and provider latency require separate server/live evaluation evidence.

accessibility.scope: Three page types and donation modal at each of three viewports; does not establish complete WCAG conformance

visualEvidence.review: All twelve captures from the corrected final production build viewed, including lower-page photos, deferred media, and donation modals at1440/390/320px. Mobile/narrow community descriptions were inspected at original resolution to confirm corrected spacing. Every card was scrolled into view and its mounted image confirmed loaded before capture.
observations: All four discovery photos are present after scrolling; no blank deferred-media placeholders remain in captures.
Quality60 photos retain recognizable subjects and useful visual detail; some fine foliage/soil texture is soft at native size, with no material subject-obscuring compression defect.
Manrope body and heading text remains readable at tested sizes. No clipped controls or page-level horizontal overflow observed.
Fundraiser support actions precede image/story on mobile; story and chart require substantial vertical scrolling.
Mobile community hero description maintains the intended space after Shared roots. at390px and320px; no remaining copy-joining defect observed.

scopeLimits: Local headless Chrome lab verification; no cross-browser coverage, physical touch-device testing, or authenticated reference-product behavior.
All campaigns and contributions are fictional/simulated; cookie-bound demo persistence does not establish cross-device identity.
Application process restart persistence is a separate parent-run check; this suite verifies reload persistence only.
Native sharing and clipboard outcomes are controlled fixtures; no recipient delivery or external conversion is claimed.
No field responsiveness, retention improvement, or Lighthouse performance-budget claim follows from these tests.
